query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'quizzes' AS kind, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id',q.id,'title',q.title,'published',q.is_published,'active',q.is_active,'test_data',q.is_test_data,'questions',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.quiz_questions qq WHERE qq.quiz_id=q.id),'attempts',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.quiz_attempts qa WHERE qa.quiz_id=q.id),'created_at',q.created_at)) FROM (SELECT id,title,is_published,is_active,is_test_data,created_at FROM public.quizzes ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10) q) AS payload UNION ALL SELECT 'attempts' AS kind, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('status',x.status,'count',x.count)) FROM (SELECT status,count(*)::integer AS count FROM public.quiz_attempts GROUP BY status ORDER BY status LIMIT 10) x) AS payload UNION ALL SELECT 'functions_without_progress_write' AS kind, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('name',x.proname,'mentions_user_progress',x.mentions_user_progress)) FROM (SELECT p.proname, position('user_progress' in pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) > 0 AS mentions_user_progress FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname IN ('get_my_quiz_catalog','get_my_quiz_detail','start_quiz_attempt','submit_quiz_attempt','get_my_quiz_attempt_result','get_my_quiz_history','get_admin_quiz_overview') ORDER BY p.proname LIMIT 10) x) AS payload UNION ALL SELECT 'lesson_progress' AS kind, (SELECT json_build_object('rows_linked_to_quiz_lessons',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.user_progress up JOIN public.quizzes q ON q.lesson_id=up.lesson_id))) AS payload) audit LIMIT 4;
